sections.label: Inflation expectations and MAS core inflation
sections.summary: Longer-term inflation expectations have fallen close to historical levels, while MAS Core Inflation stayed at 5.1% in Q4 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The five-year ahead inflation forecasts of economists and professional forecasters have been broadly unchanged over the past two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: While households’ longer-term inflation expectations picked up in late-2021 to early-2022 alongside the rise in global and domestic inflation, the latest survey from December showed that expectations have fallen to close to their historical levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Year-on-year, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) Core Inflation remained unchanged at 5.1% in the fourth quarter of 2022 compared to the third quarter, after rising continuously since the first quarter of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS, like other central banks, will continue to focus on stabilising near-term inflation and price expectations, as these weigh heavily in the formation of longer-term inflation expectations.

sections.label: Credit Suisse takeover by UBS
sections.summary: Credit Suisse will continue operating in Singapore without interruption after UBS's announced takeover, with no expected impact on banking stability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: First, Credit Suisse Group AG will continue operating in Singapore with no interruptions or restrictions following the announced takeover by UBS Group AG or UBS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The takeover is not expected to have an impact on the stability of Singapore's banking system.

sections.label: Singapore banks' exposures to failed banks
sections.summary: Singapore's banking system has insignificant exposures to failed US banks and Singapore banks' Credit Suisse exposure is insignificant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Singapore banking system has insignificant exposures to the failed banks in the US and Singapore banks have confirmed that exposure to Credit Suisse is insignificant.

sections.label: Wage-price spiral risk assessment
sections.summary: The risk of a wage-price spiral is assessed to remain contained at this point.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: For these reasons, we assess that the risk of a wage-price spiral remains contained at this point.
